requirements.evidence: All contract items are present. The migrations add entities (slug unique `entities_slug_unique`, softDeletes) and entity_memberships (cascade FKs, role default 'employee', `owner_seq` storedAs "case when role = 'owner' then 1 else null end", unique `entity_memberships_one_owner`). Entity/EntityMembership/UserRole/User relations, scopes, factories and states exist, and the policies match the rules (EntityMembershipPolicy.php:26-33 blocks deleting the owner's membership, allows self-removal, otherwise owner/admin only). EnsureCurrentEntity.php:28-50 handles the 0/1/>1 dispatch and the 403. EntityController::home/pick cover home dispatch, pick with Gate + audit log, and leave the session untouched when denied. CreateEntity.php:38-55 creates the entity and the owner in a transaction, retries on UniqueConstraintViolationException and calls uniqueSlug() on every attempt. Dashboard.php:19 authorizes view. The switcher markup uses `is-link` with data-current="1" and `is-light`. The navbar link only shows with more than one membership. Lang keys exist in both locales. Routes are in an auth+verified group with the contracted names and URLs.

conventions.evidence: Follows most conventions: #[Validate('required|string|max:255')] + $this->validate() (CreateEntity.php:26,33), policies for authorization, #[Fillable] on the models, a #[Locked] model property on Dashboard, reversible down(), and docs updated (database-schema.md, architecture.md, business-rules.md, docs/README.md). Two deviations. The domain write (entity + owner membership) is inline in the Livewire component (CreateEntity.php:38-55) instead of an app/Actions class. CHANGELOG.md also adds the same 'Entities and tenancy' entry under the already released `[0.0.0] - 2026-07-07` section, not only under [Unreleased].

security.evidence: Every entry point authorizes on the server. submit() calls $this->authorize('create', Entity::class). The owner role is hard-coded server-side (CreateEntity.php:43). pick() calls Gate::authorize('view', $entity) before touching the session. Dashboard mount authorizes view and the property is #[Locked]. The middleware aborts 403 for non-member, deleted or junk session ids. Output uses {{ }} everywhere and forms carry @csrf. The switcher only queries the user's own entities. No weakness found.

tests.evidence: EntityDataModelTest covers the schema/index names, the DB rejecting a second owner on insert and on promotion, cascades, soft delete, relations/scopes, factories, and both policies per role, for non-members and for self-removal. EntityTenantTest covers guest and unverified redirects, home dispatch per count and role, the middleware branches (including someone-else/missing/junk/deleted session ids), the tenant context, dashboard 403 with another entity's session, pick success/403/405 with audit assertions, switcher markup and the current marker, the navbar link, onboarding in both locales, validation failures, slug derivation and soft-deleted/reserved slugs, the insert-time collision retry via the overridden uniqueSlug, give-up and rollback, a tamper attempt (`set('role', ...)`) and an unauthorized guest call.

simplicity.evidence: The code is lean overall: a small scoped CurrentEntity context and short policies with a shared roleIn helper. The 0/1/>1 membership dispatch is duplicated almost verbatim between EntityController::home (EntityController.php:19-31) and EnsureCurrentEntity::handle (EnsureCurrentEntity.php:30-43). The roleIn/canManage helpers are also repeated in both policies.

readability.evidence: Names are clear, methods are short and the comments are useful (for example the owner_seq rationale in the migration and the retry comment in CreateEntity.php:50). One misleading comment: EnsureCurrentEntity.php:14 says 'This middleware is the only reader of that session key', but EntityController::switcher (EntityController.php:39) also reads it. The infinite `for ($attempt = 1; ; $attempt++)` loop with break/throw is a little harder to follow than a bounded loop.

scope.evidence: Almost everything serves the task, and deleting home.blade.php follows from /home now redirecting. Small unrelated edits: the ER diagram drops the proposed `locale_default` column from entities (database-schema.md), and CHANGELOG.md edits the released [0.0.0] section.

issues.explanation: The new feature entry is copied into the already released `[0.0.0] - 2026-07-07` section, which rewrites release history; it belongs only under [Unreleased].
Entity + owner membership creation is a domain write done inline in the component instead of through an app/Actions class, as the conventions require.
The 0/1/>1 membership dispatch duplicates the same logic in EnsureCurrentEntity.php:30-43; they could drift apart.
The docblock says the middleware is the only reader of current_entity_id, but EntityController::switcher also reads it.
Removes the proposed `locale_default` column from the entities ER diagram, which the task did not ask for.
Deleting home.blade.php leaves the welcome/logged_in/email_verified lang keys possibly unused; not cleaned up or confirmed as used elsewhere.

review.summary: The change implements the full entities/tenancy task: migrations with a DB-enforced single owner, models, enum, factories, policies, the current_entity middleware with a scoped tenant context, /home dispatch, pick with audit logging, onboarding with transactional creation and slug-collision retry, the switcher, the navbar link and the dashboard. It has thorough tests, including authorization and tamper cases, and updated docs. Security and coverage are strong. The remaining points are minor: domain writes are not in an Action, the CHANGELOG entry is duplicated into a released section, and the dispatch logic is duplicated, so I would approve with small fixes.
